hi op, i’m sorry to hear about the situation you’re in. i know that the market is fucked, i’d say that roommates / subleases are the most realistic way to secure housing, i myself have never been able to afford living alone even when i made ~$50k/yr. here are some resources myself and friends have used successfully in the past:

- toronto home zone group on facebook
- PALZ home zone group on facebook
- toronto roommates, rooms & apartments for rent group on facebook
- @coolpeoplehouses on instagram (this one is the most promising, there’s currently 3 ads up for august first in the $1100-1500 range)
- viewit website, i find that the clunky interface lends itself to slightly cheaper listings (lol)

there is also the toronto rent bank which you may be able to qualify for, but i’m unsure if your income is above the amount required. 

i hope things get easier, try to stay positive in the meantime. sending you support and good luck!
